label: Every one of the five reported commissions goes back to Jesus: he gave each power each report names
paraphrase: Every one of the five reported commissions (Matthew 16.18-19, 18.17-18, 28.18-20; John 20.21-23, 21.15-17) goes back to Jesus: he gave (or promised) each power each report names. The strong version of STMT-COMMISSION-REPORTS-GO-BACK-TO-JESUS; not a premise of any route.
